response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for pneumonia (upala pluća) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers necessary and reasonable costs for inpatient care, outpatient treatment, and prescribed medications resulting from an acute illness or injury during travel. The evidence confirms the acute illness (pneumonia) and the treatment received (intravenous antibiotics and paracetamol). There is no indication that the illness was pre-existing, intentional, or related to alcohol, extreme sports, or other exclusions."}
